native.description: Chronological prefix-state order with native full-state fallback.

random.description: Seeded permutation over the preserved prefix-state set.

analytical.description: Largest structural prefix first, using constraint and assertion counts.

bounded_refocus.description: Probe shallow, midpoint, and deepest prefixes before the remainder.

one_shot_enumeration.description: Enumerate the structurally largest prefix first, then descending prefixes.

field_principles.verdict_class: Separates positive, null, partial, blocked, and disqualified outcomes.

field_principles.frozen_comparison_contract: Freezes unit, turn, family, effort, seed, budget, tie, timeout, and stop rules before scoring.
field_principles.control_definitions: Defines native, random, analytical, bounded-refocus, and one-shot-enumeration as non-learned order-only controls.
field_principles.family_and_effort_census: Reports fixture family, split, turn, effort, and held-support counts.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Stores one unit-turn-seed-arm row with order, checks, cost, equality, timeout, and censoring evidence.
field_principles.paired_effect_rows: Reports paired held charged effects versus native and random with uncertainty from rows.
field_principles.family_effect_rows: Reports charged effects, headroom cells, no-headroom cells, and Simpson checks by family.

field_principles.exact_equality_receipt: Shows each arm's exact answer matches the audited Z3 label.
field_principles.candidate_preservation_receipt: Shows every arm preserved the same candidate set for every unit and seed.
field_principles.censoring_and_timeout_receipts: Records timeout, censoring, budget, and stop-rule symmetry.
field_principles.shortcut_attack_matrix: Attacks identity leakage, row-order leakage, unequal budgets, deleted candidates, warm-cache asymmetry, timer aliases, cherry-picked seeds, and aggregate-only claims.
field_principles.external_structural_headroom_ready_score: Opens only for charged held value beyond native and random with exact equality, multi-family support, and no shortcut failure.

field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: Rebuilds the verdict and score from per-unit, effect, equality, preservation, censoring, and attack rows.

field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Shows guarded inputs, specs, prior structural artifacts, and conductor files stayed byte-identical during the run.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares external DRIFT exact-solver structural controls with no LLM.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False because compared controls do not certify ground truth.
field_principles.field_principles: Explains why each required field exists.
field_principles.field_provenance: Maps each field to specs, inputs, rows, reducers, tests, and hashes.
field_principles.random_seed: Pins arm seeds, random controls, and attack ordering.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Detects drift in gates, rows, costs, attacks, and verdicts.
